name: HGSS Visual Overhaul
author: LucianoNeo
description: HGSS intro and overworld overhaul for Gen 1 and Gen 2. PLAYER SELECT controls matching Red, Ash, Ethan, Lyra, Kris, Kris V2, Leaf or Brendan walking, bicycle, fishing and battle-back assets. Gen 2 TRAINER ART includes identity-matched HGSS portraits for Gym Leaders, Elite Four and all audited Crystal trainer classes; Gen 2 battle Pokémon remain native.
